goal.description: Collect 4 keys to unlock and complete Chains

enable_storm_beyond.display_name: Enable The Storm and The Beyond
description: Turn this on if you want the Fog Core levels 'The Storm' and 'The Beyond' to appear as locations.
These can be accessed from a door below the red energy wall room in the level 'Questions'.
Turn this on if you want the Fog Core level 'The Night' to appear as a location.
This can be accessed from a door below the red energy wall room in the level 'Questions'.
Turn this on if you want Kalifen's levels to be locations.
These are 'My Fall', 'The Way Around', and 'Pulse Core'.
They must be accessed from Ranked Mode.
Disable this setting if you do not have these levels unlocked.
Turn this on if you want Remix levels to be locations.
These are 'Remix I', 'Remix II', and 'Remix III'.
They must be accessed from Ranked Mode.
Disable this setting if you do not have these levels unlocked.
Easter egg checks include:
- The flower pots in the Dawn, Day, and Night branches.
- The sandcastle in 'Regrowth'.
- The picnic table in 'Stability'.
- 'Welcome to Rome' in 'The Call'.
- 'Vertigo' in 'Escape'.
If turned on, Supercharge Mode is unlockable.
Must access it from Ranked Mode menu
NOTE: Some randomizer logic with supercharge can be hard (e.g. Defiance levels without a gun). Disable if you don't want this.
If turned on, the Yellow, Green, and Blue Classic Guns are unlockable.
Enable the Classic Gun by pressing 2 on your keyboard to open the items menu, then equipping it.
Disable this setting if you don't know how to rocket jump with the Classic Gun blue shot.
Traps include:
- Completing a challenge mode version of a level (Fragile, Pacifist, Beacons, Pathfinder). You can choose any level for this (even ones you have already completed).
- Listen to Demi monologue. Press 1 on your keyboard to open the journal, then double click one of the text logs. You can continue playing while Demi talks, but it will be hard to hear the music >:)
- Temporary debuffs (Fragile, Pacifist, limited energy, Supercharge Upgrade disabled).
